citation.title: Novel Artificial Neural Network Aided Structural Topology Optimization
citation.authors: Xiangrui Kong, Yuching Wu, Peng Zhu, Peng Zhi, and Qianfan Yang

claim.claimed_speedup_basis: No speed-up factor can be coded without the full text.
claim.alternatives: Abstract says computational efficiency improves and reports a reduction in the finite-element share of total operation time from over 90% to 40%.

baseline.quality_gap: Abstract says accuracy is acceptable but gives no numerical classical-versus-ML quality gap.

reporting.n_test_cases: Several numerical examples named in the abstract: cantilever, MBB, L-shape, column, and rod-supported bridge.

notes: Full text was not accessible. The publisher's MDPI article page/PDF/XML requests returned HTTP 429/403. The article abstract was readable in an open DOAJ record and official publisher search-index result; no access restriction was bypassed.
